product_metadata.title: Chefrock Heavy Duty Unbreakable Stainless Steel Measuring Cups And Slim Design Spoons For Narrow Spice Jars, Set Of 10
features: BUILT TO LAST: With attention to detail and endurance in mind chefrock measurement cups are uniquely designed with a seamless solid single metal construction making it unbreakable and without hard to clean bacteria between handle and cup you get with other brands . The set includes 1/8 cup, 1/4 cup, 1/3 cup, 1/2 cup, 1 cup 1/4 tsp 1/2 tsp 1 tsp 1/2 tbsp 1 tbsp

SLIM DESIGNED SPOONS: The rectangular design is slim to fit into narrow spice jars. You won't need to shake spices onto the spoon so you will save more and waste less of your expensive spices and of course spare yourself the mess on the kitchen counter
SUPERIOR GRIP: Coated colored silicone on handles gives you a firm nonslip comfortable grip. The sharp and bright colors will help you easily identify the cup you are looking for
18/8 STAINLESS STEEL CRAFTSMANSHIP: Made of the highest grade 18/8 stainless steel they are rust and corrosion resistant for long lasting durability you can count on and are also dishwasher safe.

ACCURATELY ENGRAVED MEASUREMENTS: Designed to handle and provide accurate measurements with dry and liquid ingredients. U.S. and metric measurement markings will not fade and are engraved large enough so that they can be read easily.
